roster_source: Scrape of public team roster pages — 281 NCAA Division I men's & women's tennis programs across 24 conferences
roster_conferences: Southland / WAC / Patriot / Big Sky / MEAC / SWAC

sources.socioeconomic: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year — public Summary File bulk files (www2.census.gov)
sources.geography: U.S. Census Bureau 2023 Gazetteer + TIGER/Line cb_2023 counties
sources.tennis_access: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (sport=tennis), © OSM contributors, ODbL
sources.rosters: Public NCAA Division I tennis team roster pages (281 programs)

limitations: Outcome = NCAA Division I tennis players on the 281 programs the scraper could read (of ~300 D1 programs); it undercounts true D1 representation for counties whose players attend the ~30 schools not covered.

Predictors use ACS 5-year vintage (roster_year - 1), clamped to the oldest/newest vintage actually available (2021-2024). The Census's public bulk files only go back to the 2021 table-based release without a much heavier legacy-format parser, so roster years 2016-2022 all reuse the same 2021 socioeconomic snapshot (see each row's acs_vintage column) — income/poverty/education/youth-population will show ~zero year-to-year variation across that span even though the roster outcome does vary. Tennis courts are a single current OSM snapshot applied to every year.
28365 of 50036 player-seasons have an international or unresolved hometown and are not placed in a U.S. county.
